Then the hang checks, which are not arms: B's env, 120 s each, Halo: Combat Evolved and JSRF.
baseline: A is coldstart1010-stack.json's B arm (ref 786f82d4bb, apk 52aa370cd4d3, plain): cold start 1 33.8 / 35.9 / 34.7, mean 34.79; warm countdown 33.58; post-GO 33.36 (1-1791703833-coldstart1010-4017651, 1-1791703256-coldstart1010-3982841, 1-1791704340-coldstart1010-4043654). lockwake1011's census of the same configuration with HAKUX_FRAMETRACE=1 at ee62b4edb5 (0-1791714330-lockwake1011-1625482, 0-1791714331-lockwake1011-1625531): cold lockw 1.53 / 1.57 ms a frame, all of it the kick site, 1.49 / 1.57 of it ended with the PFIFO thread parked; warm 0.64 / 0.81; post-GO 0.31 / 0.19.
prediction: #433 HAKUX_LOCKFREE_WAKE=1 on the stacked configuration (six switches, HAKUX_PROBE_WAITS=1, HAKUX_POSTED_PUT=1, HAKUX_SUBMIT_FRAMES=3), at NFS MW's cold race start. lockwake1011's census of that configuration (0-1791714330-lockwake1011-1625482, 0-1791714331-lockwake1011-1625531, HAKUX_FRAMETRACE=1) put all of the guest's pfifo.lock wait at one site, pfifo_post_kick(): cold 1.53 / 1.57 ms a frame (2.19 / 2.35 uninstrumented, coldstart1010 section 9), in waits of 5.4-5.5 ms on 28 % of cold frames, every one ended with the PFIFO thread still parked behind a third holder. The switch wakes the parked PFIFO thread through a QemuEvent, so the posted store never takes the lock: the guest's wait goes, the PFIFO thread's own wait for the holder stays. On the long-wait frames the frame grows by the guest's wait one for one, so the cold frame falls by most of it; it falls by less where the guest's next step is to wait on the PFIFO thread anyway. Point estimate: cold start 1 A 34.8 +- 1.0 (coldstart1010-stack.json's B arm: 34.79), B 33.9 +- 0.8, B - A -0.9 (range +0.2 .. -1.6); warm countdown B - A -0.05 (range -0.3 .. +0.2); post-GO 0 +- 0.1. Probabilities: K (B <= 34.5 and B - A <= -0.5) ~45 %; C (B - A <= -0.5) ~55 %; W ~85 %; G ~90 %; M (no hang) ~95 %. K and C passing say the guest's lock wait was the cold residual; C failing with W/G/M passing says the guest spent the freed time waiting on the PFIFO thread instead, and the next fix is the holder (OUTBOX.md: release pfifo.lock around the display fence wait).
expect_note: Named rules read by docs/lanes/lockwake1011/wakeread.py --expect (legs V, K, C, W, G, M). An arm's figure is the mean of its three runs.
